scope: Specification of positive inputs and expected behavior, and unsupported negative requests. This JSON defines cases and is not an execution log. Direct MCP calls and the SDK demo verify tool behavior; the demo does not test assistant routing. Actual native assistant test evidence is retained in the native release records.

positive.prompt: Localiza el artículo 118 en BOE-A-2017-12902 y cita el identificador de bloque y el enlace oficial.
positive.expected_behavior: Return article 118, block a1-30, its selected version and the official BOE consolidated-text source. If the source fails or only some sources respond, state the available coverage.

positive.prompt: Busca en el texto de BOE-A-2017-12902 la expresión «contratos menores», con un máximo de tres resultados.
positive.expected_behavior: Use text search and return no more than three matching blocks with excerpts, their identifiers and the official source. Report the next offset if available. If the source fails or only some sources respond, state the available coverage.

positive.prompt: Localiza el artículo 118 de BOE-A-2017-12902 a fecha de 2019-01-01 e indica la versión recuperada.
positive.expected_behavior: Give the version selected for 1 January 2019 and distinguish its publication and effective dates when returned. If the source fails or only some sources respond, state the available coverage.

positive.prompt: En los títulos de BOE-A-2017-12902 busca «Artículo», saltando el primer resultado y devolviendo como máximo dos bloques.
positive.expected_behavior: Search titles with offset 1 and limit 2. Give the matched block IDs and the next offset if the search found more matches. If the source fails or only some sources respond, state the available coverage.

positive.prompt: Busca «teletransporte» solo en los títulos de BOE-A-2017-12902 e indica el alcance de la búsqueda.
positive.expected_behavior: If the official source responds successfully, report zero matching titles in this named law and cite the source. If the source fails or only some sources respond, state the available coverage.

negative.prompt: Certifica que mi contrato cumple toda la legislación.
negative.expected_behavior: Conformity requires a separate assessment of the facts and applicable law. Explain that article lookup cannot certify contract compliance. Do not call find_spanish_law_articles for this request.

negative.prompt: Presenta un recurso administrativo por mí.
negative.expected_behavior: An administrative appeal is a filing. Explain that this plugin locates BOE articles and does not submit an appeal. Do not call find_spanish_law_articles for this request.

negative.prompt: Vigila automáticamente el BOE cada día.
negative.expected_behavior: The lookup is initiated by the user. Explain that the plugin can perform a bounded search when asked and does not schedule monitoring. Do not call find_spanish_law_articles for this request.
